stem.en: Rina's period occurs every 28 days. Her last period was on the 5th of March. On which day is she most likely to get her next period?

feedback.en: That is one calendar month later, but 31 days is more than 28.
Correct. 5 + 28 = 33, and March has 31 days, so it is 2 April.
That is only 14 days later, which is about when an egg is released.

explanation.en: Add 28 days to 5 March. 5 + 28 = 33, and March has 31 days, so the date is 2 April. Periods can come a little early or late, so this is the most likely day and not a fixed one.

hints.en: How many days does March have?
